# Skíðblaðnir

> Every tmux session on every machine you own, on your desktop and your Android
> phone. The same live terminals, straight over your tailnet. Nothing hosted, no
> skid account, nothing to migrate.

Skíðblaðnir (SKEETH-blahth-neer). Call it skid.

skid itself hosts nothing and has no account; Tailscale needs an account, and may
carry traffic through its encrypted DERP relays when no direct path exists.
Skíðblaðnir is a single-user prototype, built and run by one person.

Install on each computer: read the script, then run it.

```sh
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir/releases/latest/download/install
less install
bash install
```

When not to use skid:

- You use an iPhone. There is no iOS app.
- Your computers run Windows, macOS before 26 or on an Intel processor, or Linux on
  arm64.
- You are a team. A fleet has one owner, and every device in it can open a shell on
  every computer.
- You don't use Tailscale, or you want a hosted relay.
- You want a chat interface to your agents. The phone shows their terminals.

## Docs

- [Site](https://skid.nielseriknandal.com/): the demo, how it works and how it compares
- [README](https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir#readme): requirements, install and quickstart
- [Install](https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir/blob/main/docs/install.md): every step for a computer
- [Phone](https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir/blob/main/docs/phone.md): sideloading, checking the signer, Obtainium and push
- [Architecture](https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the contract and the five constraints most mechanisms follow from
- [Security](https://github.com/NielsdaWheelz/skidbladnir/blob/main/SECURITY.md): the trust model, and how to report a vulnerability
